headline: Minister announces fuel prices. Drivers face changes
summary: Poland's energy minister set maximum prices for Tuesday at 5.90 zloty for petrol 95, 6.56 zloty for petrol 98 and 7.32 zloty for diesel. The petrol 95 cap is unchanged while diesel falls.
why: Fuel prices feed into consumer inflation and transport costs in Poland, and government price caps directly set what retailers can charge.
original_headline: Minister ogłosił ceny paliw. Kierowców czekają zmiany
